newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia and Pakistan plan to sign an anti-drug agreement in 1997, an official said.
- A Saudi Arabian-Argentine joint economic commission, which has not met for the last four years, is likely to meet in Buenos Aires.
- The Saudi American Bank posted 921 million riyals net profit in 1996.
- Saudi barley distributers welcome new prices. Saudi Arabia said it would pay $427 million in barley subsidies this year.
